comment: Independent muse.c mbhit() -> dbridge.c destroy_drawbridge() -> explode.c scatter() witness. A debug-mode gnome Wizard level-teleports to the Castle (^V, ? menu, its castle entry), maps it, and teleports (^T) to the open ground west of the moat on the drawbridge's row. A blessed genocide of class ';' clears the moat's eels. She wishes for a wand of striking, walks two squares east, creates a hostile hill orc beside her, drops the wand and steps east. The orc picks the wand up from the square behind her and zaps it east along the row: the bolt hits her (Boing!), crosses the raised span and strikes the portcullis, so destroy_drawbridge() drops the portcullis into the moat and scatters iron-chain debris, each through scatter() with SCATTER_MAY_HIT. Before the fix, scatter() read the monster-missile stackobj() operation that the muse.c caller had forwarded and threw a TypeError. The seed was chosen by trying seeds 6602417-6602422 for one where the orc picks up the wand.
